goal: Implement permanent residential performance publishing to selected/all current servers and automatic inheritance by future servers, with explicit publish preview and durable manual rollback.
context: User explicitly removes single-canary-only UX and timed-only restriction. Add visible Select all / Clear selection and Permanent (no deadline) option defaulting to all current and future. Preserve existing timed API/UI compatibility and old experiment state. One open profile remains; existing running/kept profile can be promoted to permanent fleet without losing baselines. Persist fleet scope/duration mode, enroll future panels under same advisory lock as rollback; stop inheritance atomically before rollback and restore all targets including future admissions. Pending/offline/gated servers must never be labelled verified. No routing category expansion: keep exactly google@ads and temporary browserleaks, UDP, direct DNS choices, current client classes and all accounts. Settings are shared by existing/future users through server routes; never rewrite client identities. No disabling auth/gates, stale snapshot replay, or provider changes. Use fresh canonical source. Test PostgreSQL restart/lost response/multi-server/permanent deadline/auto-enrollment/rollback races and real UI mobile Select all/preview/publish; full Go and race/core regression. Deploy feature with no unsolicited global activation; live canary permanent selected scope and verify rollback, then user can publish the exact chosen settings globally.
commit_message: feat(residential): permanent fleet publishing and future-server inheritance
